category: market and fundamentals data API (stocks, statements, ratios, crypto, forex, news)

free_tier.stated: Basic plan USD 0/month: 250 API calls per day, end-of-day historical data, profile and reference data, up to 5 years of annual statements for US companies, 500MB of bandwidth over a trailing 30 days
free_tier.notes: Many endpoints on Basic are limited to a sample symbol set (AAPL, TSLA, AMZN and 84 more) or to US exchanges. There is no free trial of the paid plans. The cheapest paid plan is Starter at USD 19.00/month billed annually with 300 calls per minute and 20GB of trailing 30-day bandwidth; bulk endpoints come with Ultimate at USD 99.00/month billed annually.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated per call; history reaches 5 years on Basic and Starter

retention.stated: not applicable: a query API with no stored objects

egress.terms: 500MB of API bandwidth over a trailing 30 days on the free plan; 20GB on Starter, 50GB on Premium, 150GB on Ultimate

interface_detail: GET https://financialmodelingprep.com/stable/... with ?apikey= on every request; a call with the key demo answered HTTP 401 Invalid API KEY, so no keyless or demo route was found.
chaining: Statements and ratios for a sample of large US names at 250 calls a day; for prices it sits beside Tiingo's deeper end-of-day history, and FRED covers the macro side.

limits.value: 250 API calls per day on Basic
500MB of bandwidth over a trailing 30 days on the free plan

limits_note: Symbol scope: many Basic endpoints answer only for AAPL, TSLA, AMZN and 84 more, or for US exchanges. History window: 5 years. Bulk path: bulk endpoints are an Ultimate feature (paid); the FAQ paces them at once per 10 seconds, and profile or ETF bulk at once per 60 seconds.
binding_note: 250 calls a day is reached before 500MB a month for quote and statement calls; the sample symbol set narrows what those calls can reach.

identity_cost.detail: The create-account form asks for an email and a password, or a Google sign-in; the page says no card is required.

reliability_note: A call past the rate answers HTTP 429; bandwidth is counted over a trailing 30 days rather than reset on a date.
confidence_note: The daily calls, bandwidth, symbol scope and signup fields are documented on the pricing, FAQ and register pages. A probe measured that the demo key is refused with HTTP 401. The 250-call cut-off needs a free key to measure.
